_comment: Visual asset registry. Every entry is original work generated by this project. rights OWNED means procedurally generated in-repo, no third-party licence involved.

policy.syntheticPortrait: NEVER GENERATED - the portrait on /hakkimda is an authentic photograph supplied by the client
policy.generativeVideo: NOT USED - procedural shaders chosen instead
policy.removedSections: Portfolio, blog and press pages removed at client request; their research record is retained in research/.

assets.asset: Graphite wave surface with ember rim light, held at full character throughout
assets.source: Original - React Three Fiber with custom GLSL (sum-of-sines heightfield)
assets.animation: Ambient: slow time evolution and pointer tilt. No scroll coupling.
assets.mobileFallback: 90 mesh segments, DPR 1; layered SVG ridges under reduced-motion or no WebGL

assets.asset: Abstract feed grid, original interface language, deliberately not an Instagram clone
Brand name as the mark, set in that brand sector colour; real logo file used when supplied
assets.rights: OWNED - no client logo files used
assets.note: Client logo files were deliberately not scraped. Each brand name is set in its own sector colour, all contrast-checked to WCAG AA (5.28:1 or better). Drop an authorised file into public/logos/ and it switches automatically.

assets.asset: Bespoke SVG scenes - grid, vertical feed, identity system, camera, timeline, funnel, wireframe, map, vector geometry, brand system, market landscape
Client-supplied photograph, converted from HEIC, cropped to 4:5
assets.note: Delivered through next/image (AVIF/WebP, responsive). PortraitBlock retains its typographic fallback when no src is passed. No synthetic portrait was ever generated.

assets.asset: Abstract node-graph map of Ceyhan and Adana, original geometry, deliberately not Google Maps styling
